name: Comet
summary: Bright heads tracing looping paths with the music, leaving trails that drift outward and fade.
hint: Each head moves on the music clock, so the figure races when the music is loud. Its trail is last frame's picture, moved a little and faded.

params.label: Bar flare
params.help: How much the heads flare on the first beat of each bar.

params.label: Opens in a build
params.help: How far the paths widen through a build, until the drop.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.

params.label: Trail
params.help: How long the trail takes to fade to a third.

params.label: Drift
params.help: How fast the trail moves outward.
